title: Deduction of tax at source on payments to contractors and sub-contractors

effectivePeriod.sunsetNotes: Transitions to Section 393(1) Table 3 Item (i) of the Income-tax Act, 2025 effective 1 April 2026.

plainTextSummary: Any person responsible for paying any sum to a resident contractor for carrying out any work (including supply of labour for carrying out any work) in pursuance of a contract between the contractor and a specified person must deduct tax at source. Statutory Rates: (a) 1% where the payment is being made or credited to an individual or a Hindu Undivided Family (HUF); (b) 2% where the payment is being made or credited to any person other than an individual or a HUF (companies, partnership firms, LLPs, AOPs, BOIs). Thresholds: Tax is deductible if a single contract or invoice exceeds ₹30,000, OR if the aggregate of amounts paid or credited to the contractor during the financial year exceeds ₹1,00,000. Transport Operator Exemption: Under Section 194C(6), no deduction shall be made from any sum credited or paid to a contractor during the course of business of plying, hiring, or leasing goods carriages, where such contractor owns 10 or fewer goods carriages at any time during the previous year and furnishes a declaration to that effect along with their PAN. Non-PAN penalty rate under Section 206AA is 20%.

keyStatutoryThresholds.transporterExemptionRule: No deduction under Section 194C(6) if transporter owns <= 10 goods carriages and furnishes written declaration with valid PAN.
keyStatutoryThresholds.workDefinitionScope: Includes advertising, broadcasting and telecasting, carriage of goods or passengers by any mode of transport other than railways, and catering. Does not include manufacturing or supplying a product according to requirements of customer using materials purchased from a person other than such customer.
keyStatutoryThresholds.cbdtCircular23GstExclusion: TDS applies on basic contract amount excluding separately stated GST.

requiredDocumentChecklist: Vendor PAN verification (Checked against TRACES / Income Tax Portal)
Contract / Work Order specifying scope of work and payment terms
Cumulative Billing Ledger for current FY establishing if aggregate payments exceeded ₹1,00,000 or single bill exceeded ₹30,000
Section 194C(6) Transporter Declaration & vehicle RC book proofs if claiming 0% transport contractor exemption
Tax invoice with GST separately indicated (to deduct strictly on basic amount)
Lower deduction certificate under Section 197 / Section 395 (if vendor provides certificate)
